description.en: Handles recurring store purchases such as a monthly pass, pulling a schedule trigger on each renewal and tracking who currently holds it.
description.ja: 月額パスなどの継続課金を扱います。更新のたびにスケジュールのトリガーが引かれ、加入状況と有効期限を保持します。

description.en: Configures store product identifiers and renewal triggers, and tracks subscription status and expiration.
description.ja: App Store・Google Playの商品識別子、更新トリガー、有効期限を設定・管理します。
